title: IPL
body:
Stands for *Interrupt priority level*

On the [[Motorola 68000]] it is a number from 0 to 7 attached to every interrupt source,
and the three [[Interrupt Mask]] bits in the [[Status Register]] hold the level the
processor is currently running at. A request is only taken if its level is *higher* than
the mask, so raising the mask blocks everything at or below it. Level 7 is non-maskable
and always gets through.

The [[PIC]] works out which pending [[IRQs|IRQ]] has the highest level using a
[[Priority Encoder]].
